posts.cooked:
Dragon Tides (Artistic Justice Games) listed Sentinels of the Multiverse as a candidate for a cross-promotion for their kickstarter (due to restart next month). Their affiliate, Greenbriar Games, is doing another kickstarter, Yashima: Legend of the Kami Masters. Have you thought about doing a promotion with them as well?

I'd particularly like to see Fanatic as the cross promotion. The ambiguitity regarding her background makes her a great tie in (even if it's not canon). Plus I'd love to see how the miniature turns out as Greenbriar's miniatures look fantastic.
